subject: Trial success metrics, ownership and exec gate scheduling — Auriga Diagnostics
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Malone <kate.malone@aurigahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Recap + proposed trial plan for Auriga Diagnostics

Hi Kate — great chat today. Quick recap and a proposed trial plan so we can move to logistics: 

Summary of needs you shared
- Real-time clinical note summarization for ER triage (target latency < 300ms p95)
- Entity-level extraction for Dx codes with ≥ 92% extraction accuracy vs. chart review
- Strong audit logs and data residency in us-east-1 for initial trial

Proposed 4-week trial (high level)
1) Week 0 (prep): data mapping + security review
2) Week 1–3 (trial): ingest 2k anonymized notes/day, run inference on Redwood Dedicated sandbox
3) Week 4 (readout): run final evaluation, exec readout + go/no-go 

Success criteria candidate (please confirm / adjust)
- Latency: p95 < 350ms on 512-token window
- Accuracy: F1 ≥ 0.9 for entity extraction on the labeled holdout set
- Stability: < 2% error rate for inference timeouts over 72 hours
- Operational: KV cache hit rate > 60% to meet cost target

Owners (proposed)
- You: Clinical SME and label access (Auriga)
- Monica Patel (cc): Redwood trial lead / onboarding & infra config
- Ben Carter: CS lead for day-to-day escalation
- Me: commercial owner + exec readout coordination

Next steps (please reply with confirmations)
- Confirm success criteria above or list edits
- Share a single sample of de-identified notes and the labeling guideline doc
- Confirm target exec readout window (I propose week of Jun 28 — 30 min)

Attachments: [Attachment: trial-brief.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

Thanks — will loop in product if we need model variant recommendations after you confirm metrics.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.ai
(+1) 415-555-0189
From: Kate Malone <kate.malone@aurigahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial plan for Auriga Diagnostics

Diego — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming and adding a few constraints from our side: 

Confirmed items
- We can run the 4-week window. Prep time may take 5 business days for de-id and legal sign-off.
- Agree with the exec readout week of Jun 28; prefer Jun 29, 10:00–10:30am ET if available.

Success criteria edits
- Latency: p95 < 400ms (our internal infra has occasional spikes) — can you confirm Redwood can route to us-east-1?
- Accuracy: entity extraction F1 ≥ 0.9 on ICD+SNOMED mapping; we'll provide the holdout set (approx 1,000 labeled notes)
- Security: SOC2-related questions — we will need the security questionnaire returned before prep starts

Procurement note
- Procurement expects a short-term SOW for the trial and then a demonstration of outcomes before PO. Expect legal review to take up to 7 business days.

Attached: security-questionnaire.pdf (we filled initial fields; please return the rest)

Kate Malone
Director, Clinical AI | Auriga Diagnostics
kate.malone@aurigahealth.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Malone <kate.malone@aurigahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial plan for Auriga Diagnostics

Kate — perfect, thanks for the clarifications. Quick updates and firmed-up plan below.

Operational confirmations
- Yes — we will route trial traffic to us-east-1 dedicated sandbox. Monica will share the endpoint and network steps.
- We can accept the 1,000-note holdout for the accuracy gate. Please deliver via the secure Drive link (see below).

Revised success criteria (final draft)
- Latency: p95 < 400ms (512-token window) on Redwood Dedicated in us-east-1
- Accuracy: Entity extraction F1 ≥ 0.90 on Auriga holdout (1,000 notes)
- Reliability: < 2% timeout/error rate over the 72-hour continuous run during week 3
- Security: completed security questionnaire + Egress policy signed before ingest

Trial roles and owners (final)
- Auriga: Kate Malone — clinical owner + labeled holdout
- Redwood: Monica Patel — trial technical lead (config, infra), Ben Carter — CS escalation and onboarding, Diego — commercial / exec readout owner

Timeline (firm)
- Jun 18–22: legal & security questionnaire signoff + sample notes delivered
- Jun 23–25: infra setup, dataset ingest, smoke tests
- Jun 26–Jun 27: full-run data collection for evaluation
- Jun 29: Exec readout (30 min) + go/no-go decision

Please confirm: Jun 29, 10:00am ET works for the Auriga execs? If yes, I'll block and send a calendar invite with a short agenda and required deliverables.

Attachments: [Attachment: trial-config.yaml (YAML, 6KB)]

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/auriga-trial-2027

Diego
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:30:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Auriga trial — validation checklist & SLOs for Monica

Monica / Ben — looping you both to confirm readiness against the runbook. Below are the items I need confirmed by EOD Jun 23 so we can hit the trial timeline: 

Checklist for Monica (trial lead)
- Endpoint: Dedicated us-east-1 sandbox ready and accessible to Auriga network team
- KV cache prewarm config applied (goal: >60% hit rate)
- Tokenization & model variant chosen (recommend: redwood-qual-1-q4)
- Logging: full audit log retention enabled for 30 days (per Auriga ask)
- Load test: run 10k concurrent short requests to validate p95 before ingest

Checklist for Ben (CS)
- Onboarding doc ready and shared to Auriga drive
- Monitoring alert thresholds and escalation playbook confirmed

Ask: Monica — can you reply on this thread with the endpoint and the prewarm confirmation? Ben — can you prepare the 15-min onboarding checklist for Jun 23?

Thanks — I will prepare the exec readout slide deck template and the short mutual action plan (attached).

Attachments: [Attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx (DOCX, 48KB)]

Diego
From: Kate Malone <kate.malone@aurigahealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial plan for Auriga Diagnostics

Diego / Monica / Ben — thanks for the clear checklist. Confirmations from Auriga: 

- Jun 29, 10:00am ET confirmed for exec readout (I'll invite: myself, our Head of Data Science, and our CIO — 3 execs)
- Procurement: SOW for the trial is in review; we expect signature by Jun 25 if security questionnaire returns complete
- Dataset: we will upload the de-identified 1,000-note holdout to the Drive folder by Jun 22 EOD

One ask for the readout agenda: can you include a 5-min ops summary (latency & errors) and a 5-min compliance note (audit/log footprint)? That will help our CIO.

Thanks — Kate

Kate Malone
Director, Clinical AI | Auriga Diagnostics
